h1: Devasom Hua Hin Resort — a private-beach boutique that bottles old Hua Hin charm
intro: Picture this: a white colonial-style building by the sand, timber verandas, sheer curtains drifting in the breeze, soft jazz floating over from the bar — Devasom Hua Hin Resort is a tiny 23-room boutique on a private stretch of Cha-am beach that reimagines 1920s Hua Hin in a Victorian Contemporary key. Every room faces the sea, and the beach runs for kilometres with barely another soul on it. Scored 9.4 from 105 reviews on Trip.com. From approx. ฿4,000/night.

Sea-view guest room decorated in Victorian Contemporary style

body.html: Devasom opened around 2010 and marked its 15th anniversary in 2025 — making it one of the pioneering beach boutiques of the Cha-am/Hua Hin strip. What sets it apart from the big resorts is its scale: just 23 rooms and villas, every one facing the sea. The owners set out to tell the story of old Hua Hin, from the white high-roofed building and timber furniture to the jazz that plays softly all day.

Rooms start with the Seaside Deluxe at 50 sqm, stepping up to the Seaside Suite and Devasom Signature Suite at 60 sqm, then the Beach Villa and Beachfront Villa groups closest to the sand. They run noticeably larger than the typical 5-star room in this area, decked in white, blue and timber tones with a veranda for catching the sea breeze. Many guests say the rooms were the thing that impressed them most — Trip.com's cleanliness sub-score sits at 9.6, and that rings true.
"Opened the curtains in the morning and the sea filled the window — walked straight down to the sand without crossing a road. The beach was so quiet it felt genuinely private."

The beach out front is what guests mention most. It's a long, quiet stretch where you can walk for kilometres and barely pass another tourist — a world away from the crowded sands of central Hua Hin. The outdoor pool is positioned to look out to sea, ideal for an evening drink. One honest note from real reviews: the right-hand side of the beach has scattered small rocks in places, so wear water shoes or watch your step going in.

Breakfast earns steady praise — small resort, but a wide spread with cooked-to-order items alongside the usual buffet. The main restaurant, PRIBPRI Heritage Table, serves old-recipe Thai food, while Deva Bistro runs all day. Service is another standout — few staff, but attentive, remembering guests' names, with the warm feel of a small place that looks after everyone. The 9.4 service score matches the sentiment.

The location sits on Petchkasem Road at Km.207 on the Cha-am side — fairly far from central Hua Hin and the night market. The quiet is the draw, but it means relying on transport if you want to eat off-site. The resort runs a shuttle (last run around 6pm) and taxis are available. If you want to hit markets and night strolls every evening it'll feel remote, but if you came to switch off by the sea, this is exactly the setting you're after.

Honestly, Devasom isn't for party-goers or families with small kids wanting water parks and packed activity schedules. Prices start around ฿4,000–฿6,000/night for the Seaside rooms, rising to ฿8,000+ for a Beachfront Villa in high season. But if you're after a quiet seaside escape for couples or a restful trip — clean rooms, a private beach, warm service and a slice of old Hua Hin charm that's hard to find — it lands very well at this price.

A tip from following the reviews here: if the budget stretches, book a Beach Villa or Beachfront Villa closest to the sand — you step from your room straight onto the beach, and it's worth more than a building room. Weekdays usually carry clearly better rates than Saturday–Sunday, so compare a few platforms before booking.

honestSummary: Devasom Hua Hin Resort is at its best for travellers who want a quiet, private-beach boutique escape — clean rooms, a long private beach, warm service and a slice of old Hua Hin charm that's hard to find. The trade-offs are an out-of-town location and limited on-site dining.
honestChecks: If you want to hit night markets and eat off-site every evening — it's far from town and you'll rely on transport each time → consider staying in central Hua Hin within walking distance of restaurants.
If you're travelling as a big family with small kids wanting water parks and activities — Devasom leans toward adult tranquillity → a larger resort with a kids' club fits better.
If you're booking a long weekend or high season — there are only 23 rooms and they fill fast as rates rise → book ahead and lock a free-cancellation rate first.

faqTitle: FAQ — Devasom Hua Hin Resort, Cha-am

faq.q: Where is Devasom Hua Hin Resort — is it in Cha-am or Hua Hin?
faq.a: Devasom sits on Petchkasem Road at Km.207 on the Cha-am side, in Phetchaburi Province, on a private beach between Cha-am and Hua Hin. Despite the name, it's actually in Cha-am district, about 20 minutes' drive from central Hua Hin. A shuttle into town is available.

faq.q: What's the starting price at Devasom and what rooms are there?
faq.a: Prices start around ฿4,000/night for the Seaside Deluxe (50 sqm). It steps up to the Seaside Suite and Signature Suite (60 sqm), with the Beachfront Villa group — closest to the sand — at roughly ฿8,000+ in high season. Every room has a sea view; rates vary by season, so compare a few platforms before booking.

It's ideal for couples, honeymooners, or anyone wanting a quiet seaside escape. Romantic mood, a small private 23-room resort, a peaceful beach. It's not the pick for party-goers or families with small kids wanting water parks and a busy activity schedule.

faq.q: What is the beach at Devasom like — can you swim?
faq.a: The beach out front is a long, quiet stretch you can walk for kilometres with barely anyone around. You can swim, with one caveat: the right-hand side has scattered small rocks in places, so water shoes or care are wise. Most guests prefer this quiet, private beach to the busy town sands.

faq.q: How do you get there from Bangkok — is it far?
faq.a: From Bangkok it's about a 2.5–3 hour drive down Petchkasem Road to Cha-am. You can also take a van or coach to Cha-am or Hua Hin and grab a taxi onward. The resort is right on Petchkasem Road at Km.207, easy to find, with a shuttle into town.

faq.q: What are the food and restaurants like at the resort?
faq.a: There's PRIBPRI Heritage Table serving old-recipe Thai food and Deva Bistro open all day. Breakfast is praised as varied with cooked-to-order items. The limitation is the small number of on-site dining options — for more variety you'll drive into town.
